questions.text: Do we scope the proposal on the weekly margin overview, or on the ERP timesheet entry?

questions.text: Can we state the 3–4 hours every Monday as the current manual cost in the proposal?

questions.text: Are the foremen's Excel timesheets in a consistent format we can ingest?

questions.text: Is the 15% margin threshold the KPI we should show in the dashboard?
